policy: Only HIGH/CRITICAL production advisories may be listed. Every entry needs an owner, a reason, an exit condition, and expires no later than the review date. Expired entries fail the gate.

exceptions.reason: No fixed zod 3.x release exists (first patched version is 4.6.6). Exposure is bounded: the app is guest-only and local-first, save import is capped at MAX_IMPORT_LENGTH (1 MB), and every array in gameSaveSchema has an explicit .max() bound, so the oversized-unbounded-array precondition cannot be supplied through the only untrusted input path.
exceptions.exitCondition: Migrate lib/storage/schema.ts and its tests to zod >=4.6.6, remove this entry, and re-run npm run audit:gate before 2026-12-15.
